scope: Collect the distinct unnamed resident FILE_NAME attribute instances of one captured NTFS3.0/3.1 base FILE and its declared extension records. This is supplied-record validation and lossless name inventory, not native acquisition, index-to-target membership, case collation, lookup, namespace/tree/content completeness or full original0.1.0 qualification.
ownership: Add runtime/capture/ntfs_names.h/.cpp for the separate filename API. Extract the currently implemented record/list selection from ntfs_stream.cpp into private ntfs_attributes_detail.h/.cpp, shared by exactly the stream joiner and filename collector in disked_ntfs_stream. Preserve existing stream API, diagnostics, observations and behavior. Reuse portable FILE/fixup/attribute/list/filename decoders; no new opener, OS call, provider, command, scheduler or public ABI.
inputs: NtfsFilenameRequest owns context, full nonzero-sequence base reference, volume/cluster/record geometry, version and NtfsStreamJoinLimits. Derive an exact type0x30 empty raw-attribute-name selector internally; callers cannot substitute another type. Input arrays/spans are readable, disjoint and stable for the call. Reuse all existing stream-control validation, input count/byte/context/ordinal uniqueness and full sequence/base/optional-record-number checks. Lazy consumed records require flags1 or3, complete FILE/fixups/attribute framing and unique instance IDs. Assertions are not source provenance.
selection: Without ATTRIBUTE_LIST, collect every type0x30 attribute in physical attribute order, including zero instances. With the existing single bounded resident or context/base/instance/protected-base-hash-bound nonresident ATTRIBUTE_LIST, validate complete framing and every reference as before; collect every type0x30 descriptor in list encounter order and bind exact record/reference/instance/type/lowVCN0. Reject duplicate selected keys, conflicting generations, present stale/wrong-owner/missing-instance metadata and matching unlisted attributes. Missing-record dependencies are the existing complete unique full-reference set only after known list/present-record validation. Zero selected FILE_NAME descriptors is a complete empty inventory only when no consumed record contains an unlisted filename. Extra supplied but unreferenced records do not become selected. For this filename mode, any named type0x30 descriptor or consumed type0x30 attribute is an explicit ntfs_names_attribute_name failure; never silently hide it.
values: Each selected FILE_NAME is an unnamed flags0 resident value, with existing supported resident_flags0/1 retained as observed data; other form/feature flags fail ntfs_names_attribute_form. Decode with de_ntfs_filename_read. Require its complete envelope, known namespace code0..3, nonzero full parent sequence and nonempty counted name; any decoder issue yields ntfs_names_value. Do not reject raw UTF16LE units, unpaired surrogates, embedded NUL/control units or differently cased names merely for presentation. Do not normalize, sort, deduplicate or merge equal names/parents/namespaces from distinct record-instance identities. A long name, DOS alias and different hard-link parent remain separate observations; no cross-parent membership is claimed. Preserve opaque duplicated-information and trailing suffix bytes without interpreting or comparing them as authority.
outputs: NtfsFilename owns exact selected record full reference, instance, resident_flags, parent full reference, namespace byte, raw UTF16LE name and entire original FILE_NAME value bytes. NtfsFilenamesResult owns an optional const vector of names, nonnull only for a complete inventory (including empty), required_records, and bounded org.disked.ntfs-filename-collection-prototype/1 observation. No borrowed input views survive. The observation retains exact context/base/version, selected valid prefix, counts, original protected-record hashes, value/name/suffix hashes, raw name and opaque duplicated-information hex, source-assertion flags and explicit unverified target_membership/collation/namespace claims. Any stopped result has no typed complete inventory; a valid prefix is not silently treated as complete. atomic_snapshot/current_source_authority/effects_authorized stay false.
budgets: Keep existing defaults/maxima for supplied records/bytes, attributes/list entries/runs/list bytes/output; do not increase native limits or deadlines. Filename count is bounded by the global selected attribute quota. Reuse4096 fixed report reserve,256 per consumed record and192 per nonresident-list mapping run. Charge512+2*original value bytes+2*name bytes per valid filename before copying variable values or appending its row. Output-budget exhaustion returns ntfs_join_output_budget with bounded prefixes and no typed inventory; exact final JSON serialization also enforces the selected output cap. The ordinary stream path retains its old part/run charges and outputs. Bounds describe algorithmic storage, not an OS heap quota.
validation: Define independently generated protected FILE/list/value expectations before native evaluation: both versions, empty/single/multiple names, hard-link parents and DOS aliases, identical names with distinct instances, raw control/NUL/surrogate/max255-unit names, opaque bytes/suffix and original hashes, resident/nonresident lists, multiple extension instances, reversed descriptor/input order and complete missing dependencies. Exercise exact and exceeded record/byte/attribute/list/run/output quotas, invalid request/context/ordinal/sequence/base/optional number, torn/truncated FILE/list/name/value, named/nonresident/flagged/unknown namespace/zero parent/unlisted/duplicate/conflicting descriptors. Guard borrowed memory and release it before examining the owned result. Compare unchanged old stream and source-bound capture/worker/frontend regressions. Require clean all-target native build, complete current native campaign, standalone headers, imports/boundaries/source map, full tooling and exact manifest/context/source identities. Label Win32/other hosts unverified unless actually run.

primary_sources.supports: Version3.0/3.1 FILE_NAME has a full parent reference and counted Unicode representation; multiple filename attributes can describe directory associations.
Attribute type0x30 denotes FILE_NAME; an instance identifies an attribute within its FILE record; resident and nonresident forms have distinct value ownership.
